verdict.rationale: The project publishes a first-party agent-oriented doc, AGENTS.md, in its repo that documents the CLI command surface (add, list, update, init, sync, install). The Agent Skills specification is also served as a markdown file (specification.md), which an agent can be pointed at directly. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt, and a probe for a markdown docs variant (skills.md) returned HTTP 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, agent-readable markdown versions of the main docs site, and independent or hands-on confirmation of pointing an agent at these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: `skills add <pkg>` | Install skills from git repos, URLs, or local paths
skills experimental_sync    | Sync skills from node_modules into agent dirs
The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
